# dsh-plugin-skill-manager
**English** | 简体中文
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds a **Skills** tab to the web UI conversation view ring (nex
t to *Chat* and *Trajectory*). It lists every available skill with a live search box and a per-skill
**enable / disable** switch, plus a bulk **enable-all / disable-all** toggle.
Disabling a skill writes `disable-model-invocation: true` into the skill's `SKILL.md` frontmatter, s
o the model-facing skill catalog drops it while the user-facing surface keeps it — the skill stays v
isible in the list and can be re-enabled at any time.
## Features

- 🗂️ **Skills tab** registered into the `conversation.view` slot, alongside Chat and Trajectory
- 🔍

**Search box** filtering by skill name or description
- 🔘 **Bulk switch**: enable or disable every v

isible skill at once
- 🔄 **Live list**: the tab drops the host's cached catalog on open, polls a che

ap structure revision every 3 s while visible, and offers a **Reload** button
- 🔒 **Read-only rows**
: skills with no writable `SKILL.md` (application-bundled skills such as `office-docx` / `office-ppt
x` / `office-xlsx`, and runtime-registered skills) render with a *Built-in* badge and no toggle, ins
tead of failing with `skill "…" not found`
## How it works
The plugin ships two halves in one npm package:
| Half | Entry | What it does |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Registers `POST /api/skill-manager/toggle`, `…/packages`, `…/refresh`, and
`…/status` on the DSH web server, resolves the skill's `SKILL.md` through the registry and the disk
(project roots first, then user roots), rewrites its frontmatter, and watches the user skill roots

for new packages |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | Registers the Skills conversation-view tab, renders
the list from the `skills.list` RPC, and calls the host routes on toggle, reload, and revision poll
he list from the `skills.list` RPC, and calls the host routes on toggle, reload, and revision poll |

ofiles/web" add --force file:./dsh-plugin-skill-manager` and restart DSH.
## Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Remove `dsh-plugin-skill-manager` from `dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json`,
then restart DSH. Skills disabled by the plugin keep their frontmatter; re-enable them with the plug
in, or delete the `disable-model-invocation` line manually.
